summary.text: Dayna Alane Smith is the Workers Party candidate on the November 3, 2026, general-election ballot for South Carolina's 2nd Congressional District. She previously ran in a 2018 special Democratic primary for South Carolina State Senate District 20. Little other public biographical information was found.

paragraphs.text: Smith ran in the August 14, 2018, special Democratic primary for South Carolina State Senate District 20, finishing second with 362 votes (11.0%) behind Dick Harpootlian (80.7%). Ballotpedia lists her as the Workers Party candidate in the 2026 general election and notes that she had not completed its 2026 Candidate Connection survey.
